patterns.note: Alternating dark and light background sections create clear visual breaks and hierarchy down the page.
A sophisticated serif font is used for all primary headings, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A high-contrast dark mode aesthetic dominates, using a very dark grey/black as the primary background, white text, and a single vibrant blue for branding and calls to action.
The hero image subtly zooms in and moves upwards as the user scrolls, creating a gentle parallax effect.
The transparent navigation bar transforms into an opaque dark bar with white text upon scrolling past the hero section.
A dedicated 'What Our Users Say' section features a large, centered quote with a subtle quotation mark icon, emphasizing social proof.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background image with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure text readability, which subtly parallaxes by zooming and shifting vertically on scroll.
The primary navigation bar starts as transparent over the hero image with light-colored links, then transitions to a solid dark background with white links and logo as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections utilize a consistent structure of a main heading, a short introductory paragraph, and a call-to-action button, often paired with an image or image grid, alternating between dark and light background themes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual impact, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and input fields, with most other elements featuring sharp, defined edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density throughout content sections, with a notably airy hero section that allows the imagery and main headline to breathe.

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold and counter-intuitive brand message, 'The dating app designed to be deleted,' which is prominently displayed in the hero. This unique value proposition is supported by a clean, editorial design that feels premium and trustworthy, distinguishing it from typical dating app marketing.
